notes: I checked commit 7432f3b against each earlier finding in the code. Typecheck is clean and all 23 agents tests pass (~17 s). Fixed: venueTermsProblems now checks the sales window (10 min to 6 h from now) and how long after the deadline the show is. The double-booking window is one demo day (2 s). The share tolerance is 500 bps. The README says the venue and fan keys are public demo keys. keeper-cli exits non-zero when every tick failed. The fan-budget line is logged once per band. Partly fixed: the ask now infers the draw (drawBehind = capacity x 20), but it uses the offer verdict only for off-genre bands below the 40-ticket cap, so a fitting genre with a mis-sized room is still signed. The memcmp offset is right. The Show layout is 8 (discriminator) + 5 x 32 (pubkeys) + date 8 + price 8 + capacity 4 + threshold_bps 2 + deadline 8 + band_bps 2 + venue_bps 2 + sold 4 + refunded 4 + escrow 8 = 218, and the state enum follows. That matches state.rs and packages/sdk/idl. Single-byte base58 of 0..3 is '1'..'4', so Proposed, OnSale, Confirmed and Cancelled are read and Settled is skipped. Cancelled shows and proposals that expired unanswered are still read on every tick, forever, and the read is now four getProgramAccounts calls per tick. The per-band cap now comes from on-chain intake (gross_settled_lamports plus ticketsSold x price on the shows still read), so it holds across runs. Its accounting is wrong, though. Each simulated purchase also pays the rent for a ~124-byte Ticket account (~0.00175 SOL, paid by the keeper payer). That rent is never returned: refunds close it to the public-key fan, and settled tickets keep it. At the default 20 € (200,000 lamports) the rent is 4-9x the ticket price, so the 0.05 SOL per-band cap and the 0.3 SOL per-run cap, both counted in ticket price only, understate real spend by several times. New band wallets still get fresh budgets (the comment 'holds across runs and wallets' is wrong about wallets). Each tick can still overshoot the cap by maxBuysPerTick x 2 x price. Because the cap counts lifetime intake, a band's second tour (or a first tour at 40 € or more) gets few or no simulated fans and its shows cancel. Neither the transcript nor the dashboard says why. The FakeChain ignores the memcmp filters and returns every show to each of the four calls, so in the tests each show appears four times: proposals are answered four times (three fail quietly), crank work and intake are quadrupled. Neither the filter nor the intake arithmetic is tested; the cap test sets the cap to 0. Still open: the FanSim is not seeded from existing tickets and 'already in use' is retried. The fans' fairness re-check passes [] for other dates. The mainnet guard is a deny-list. keeper.yml still greps away the keeper's own 429 tick failures. band-agent.ts hard-codes the 2 s demo day. orchestrator.ts still uses toFixed(4). There are no tests for the per-run cap, the low-balance pause, failing ticks or the guard. A 10-minute manual run can still exceed the 12-minute job timeout. The core agent work (negotiation, route sanity, validated LLM output, heuristic fallbacks) stays strong. The keeper's anti-drain story is better but not yet correct.

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:39-40,255-259: the cap counts the band's lifetime intake, including real buyers and settled tours. A band's second tour, or a 9-show first tour at 40 € or more (book.ts showsFor, MAX_TICKETS 40), runs out of simulated fans part-way, and its later shows cancel for budget, not demand. The reason only reaches the keeper's console. packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:180-186,255: bandInfo caches grossSettledLamports for the whole run. A show that settles mid-run leaves the filtered read (state Settled), so its gross drops out of intake while the cached grossSettled does not include it yet, and the band's lifetime falls. Invalidate bands.get(profile) when crank.run settles one of that band's shows, or refetch the band profile each tick for bands that are selling

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:194,215,236: the state filter skips only Settled. Cancelled shows (never closed by the program) and Proposed shows past their deadline (never answered, or at non-seed venues) are still read on every tick, forever, now through four getProgramAccounts calls per 15 s on a rate-limited RPC. Keep a set of finished pubkeys across runs (for example in the Actions cache), or read state with one call (dataSlice offset 218, length 1) and then getMultipleAccountsInfo on the live ones

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:70-72: the offer verdict is only used for off-genre bands below 40 tickets. An in-genre crafted proposal whose inferred draw does not fit the room (e.g. 12 tickets at a 2,000 room: ratio 0.12) is signed, and the 500 bps tolerance lets any crafted proposal pay the venue 5 points under its ask. Reject when !d.offer and p.capacity < maxCapacity regardless of genre, and narrow the tolerance to the 300 bps strongHistory discount
